## Developer News

[WG Workload Conformance has been formed](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/pull/9139); the new working group is chartered under SIG Apps and SIG Architecture to define workload-level conformance signals, with a [Slack channel](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/pull/9223) and SIG diagram update already in place.

[WG Node Identity held its first meeting](https://groups.google.com/a/kubernetes.io/g/dev/c/NMm6L-CocOs) on October 14 and has [published its meeting schedule and OWNERS](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/pull/9220).

[SIG Scheduling has proposed leadership changes](https://groups.google.com/a/kubernetes.io/g/dev/c/X-OG8zIphH8): Heba Elayoty would join as Chair and Matt Matejczyk as Tech Lead; Kensei Nakada would step down as Chair while remaining a Tech Lead. The changes take effect after lazy consensus on October 26.

[SIG Cluster Lifecycle has a tech lead transition](https://groups.google.com/a/kubernetes.io/g/dev/c/GtGJ202aOvQ): Fabrizio Pandini steps down from the Tech Lead role, with Ciprian Hacman and Stefan Bueringer stepping in.

SIG Testing has [added ktesting as a subproject](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/pull/9183).

SIG CLI has [updated the kubectl conventions document](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/pull/9201), tightening guidance on flag naming, output formatting, and command structure for new kubectl contributions.

SIG ContribEx has [updated the Slack guidelines around #announcements and job listings](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/pull/9216) to clarify moderated submissions to #announcements and the requirements for job and resume submissions to #kubernetes-careers.

The [Kubernetes contributor site now supports dark mode](https://github.com/kubernetes/contributor-site/pull/846); kubernetes.dev follows your system theme by default, adds a light/dark toggle to the navbar.


## Release Schedule

**Next Deadline: [Docs: Open placeholder PRs](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/blob/master/releases/release_phases.md#docs), [October 29](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/tree/master/releases/release-1.38#timeline)**

The v1.38 timeline [schedules alpha.3 for October 21](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/tree/master/releases/release-1.38#timeline). Contributors whose enhancements need documentation should open placeholder PRs against `dev-1.38` by October 29.

November patch releases are targeted for [November 10](https://kubernetes.io/releases/patch-releases/), with cherry-pick PRs due November 6.

## Featured PRs

### [143188: [WAS] KEP-5547: Promote Job Scheduling feature gate to Beta](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/143188)

[helayoty](https://github.com/helayoty) promoted the `WorkloadWithJob` feature gate to Beta as part of [KEP-5547](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-apps/5547-integrate-workload-apis-with-job-controller). This integrates Workload-aware Scheduling (WAS) APIs into the Kubernetes Job controller, allowing Jobs to express scheduling intent through `spec.scheduling`⁠, including gang scheduling and topology constraints. The controller translates this configuration into `Workload` and `PodGroup` objects, enabling related Pods to be scheduled according to the workload's requirements. The feature remains disabled by default in this promotion, giving clusters control over when to enable the integration.

### [143160: KEP-5793: Add staticOrder to control mutating webhook merge order](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/143160)

[aramase](https://github.com/aramase) added the `staticOrder` field to `WebhookAdmissionConfiguration` as part of [KEP-5793](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-api-machinery/5793-manifest-based-admission-control-config). Previously, manifest-based mutating admission webhooks always ran before webhooks registered through the API, so migrating a webhook to a manifest could change the order in which mutations were applied. The new configuration supports three ordering modes: `StaticFirst` to preserve the existing behavior, `StaticLast` to run manifest-based webhooks afterward, and `ByName` to sort both sets together by configuration name. This gives cluster administrators more control over admission ordering when using manifest-based admission control, while caching the merged webhook list avoids adding per-request processing overhead.


## KEP of the Week

### [KEP-5502: EmptyDir Volume Permission Mode](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-storage/5502-emptydir-volume-mode/README.md)

KEP-5502 adds an optional `mode` field to `EmptyDirVolumeSource`, allowing permissions such as `0750` or the sticky bit (`01777`) without an init container running `chmod`. With `EmptyDirVolumeMode` enabled, kubelet applies the requested mode when creating the directory; omitting it preserves `0777`. Values must be between `0000` and `01777`. The field has no effect on Windows, and `fsGroup` can modify the resulting permissions.

[Nispriha Jagan](https://github.com/nispriha) and [Neeraj Krishna Gopalakrishna](https://github.com/ngopalak-redhat) authored the KEP for SIG Storage with SIG Node, building on a [2022 request for sticky-bit support](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/110835). The [KEP merged in June](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/6200), and its [Alpha implementation is merged](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/140244) for v1.37. The [Beta KEP update merged October 5](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/6437) and targets Beta in v1.38; the KEP's status remains `implementable`.
